title: Scheduled-layer drift (pg_cron registration vs. the health check)
notes: Compares EXPECTED_CRON_JOBS in scripts/lib/cron-health.mjs against every job name a `cron.schedule('<name>'` call registers across prisma/migrations/*cron*/migration.sql — no database, no secrets, so this runs on every PR. This is the exact class of drift the 2026-09-01 review found (the 4 baseline jobs were registered nowhere the health check could see, for 5 months, entirely invisible until someone queried prod directly): a new *cron*-named migration that schedules a job the health check does not know about (unexpected_registered_jobs) or that stops re-registering one it does (unregistered_expected_jobs) fails this gate immediately, on the migration diff, instead of five months later in prod.
